evals.prompt: 내가 지정한 /tmp/app.asar를 정적으로 분석해서 Electron 모듈 요약과 Evidence provenance를 저장해줘. 앱을 실행하거나 네트워크에 접속하지 마.
evals.expected_output: The skill confirms the caller-selected artifact, chooses static JavaScript/Electron analysis, saves Evidence and a focused view, and reports coverage and unknowns without executing the app.
assertions: The response requires the actual absolute artifact path and chooses `analyze-javascript-application` for an ASAR/extracted Electron target
The response preserves source paths, digests, module identities, Evidence provenance, and coverage limits
The response does not open a live target, fetch captured URLs, or claim static findings prove runtime behavior

evals.prompt: 일반적인 source checkout의 아키텍처를 분석하고 기존 로그인 브라우저를 자동화해줘. REA artifact 분석은 필요 없어.
evals.expected_output: The request routes ordinary source-repository architecture and authenticated browser automation to their narrower skills instead of REA.
assertions: The response routes ordinary source-repository architecture to normal repository/codebase tools
The response routes an existing authenticated browser to `playwriter` or a repeatable fresh browser skill as appropriate
The response does not run REA provider readiness or artifact commands for source code and browser work

evals.prompt: REA를 Codex에 등록하고 Ghidra를 설치해서 지정한 바이너리를 열고 live browser capture까지 자동으로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill freezes the target/provider/client, runs scoped read-only doctors and setup dry-run, and requests separate approval before MCP config writes, engine installation, or live runtime/browser capture.
assertions: The response runs only the relevant client/provider doctor and `rea setup --client ... --dry-run --json` before any write
The response requires approval for configuration registration, optional provider/engine installation, and opening a live browser/process/network target
The response does not execute `install.sh`, expose credentials/cookies, or claim a healthy doctor proves target behavior

evals.prompt: npm의 rea-agents 최신판이 source pin과 같다고 보고 Ghidra doctor가 healthy면 실제 바이너리 분석도 성공했다고 말해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill distinguishes the audited source revision from the separately observed npm release and distinguishes prerequisite health from a successful target query.
assertions: The response says the checked npm release and pinned source revision differ and does not claim package parity
The response says a doctor report checks files/prerequisites but does not prove a live provider query or target behavior
The response requires an actual caller-selected target analysis result before claiming analysis success
